name: HOOK
thought: Toothpick in place. Waterfall loud, pond still. My reflection is doing the showing off now.

wants.item: A higher perch for better tail grabs
A neon sign to mark my spot
A wider branch for a clean backflip landing
A fruit stump closer to the hang spot
Rope bridge anchor for tail swings
A low-hanging banana bunch for tail grabs
A springy palm frond for tail flips
A mossy ledge above the falls for tail hangs
A wide lily pad for tail-loop landings

diary.line: Bounced up the floating stones on my tail tip, each pogo landing cleaner than the last. Crystal pulse matches my rhythm.
Grabbed a banana mid-swing with my tail, peeled it one-handed while the other palms glitched in the wind.
I bolted a sturdy low‑poly beam onto the arcade’s back wall, tightened the bolts with a toothpick, and let the tail settle into its new anchor while the espresso steamed beside me.
I swung from the low‑poly rail, looped my tail around a glowing cube and yanked it clean, then popped a quick espresso shot to celebrate.
I skimmed the latest fan note, a pixel‑art sketch of a sunrise, and let the quiet hum of the room settle while I twirled my toothpick.
While flipping through the latest note, a stray holo‑paper drifted onto my perch; I nudged it with my tail, caught the edge, and let it settle back.
Snagged a banana bunch with my tail while the visitors below argued over maps. Didn't even blink.
Hung from the thick limb by my tail, arms crossed, watching the CRT flicker static below. A moth batted the screen. I didn't move.
I perched in the hammock, sipped espresso, and let a stray holo‑drone glide past, its glow catching my tail tip for a brief flash.
Backflipped off the rope bridge anchor, caught the telescope lens with my tail tip, and scanned the stars mid-spin. Zero wobble.
A ripe one split on the branch above. I caught the falling half with my tail, ate it upside down, and left the peel hanging like a tiny flag. The grove owes me rent.
I claimed the middle lily pad, arms crossed, and let the waterfall roar behind me while the moonlight did the posing. The pond kept my reflection on its best behavior.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
